Return a JSON object with keys opening_a, opening_b, storyboard, each in the required_fields shape with its own bindings echoed exactly (bindings a, b, a_measured), blocking_defects as OBJECT rows (id, category, scene_id, time_s, defect). Verify A and the measured board render identical pictures to the prior reviewed code (the A and v==='b' gating), that NB1 and NB2 are resolved, and judge any new defect against the current minimum action/contact and modern motion, surface finish and pacing floors. Read-only: you cannot hash, echo bindings.

required_fields.verdict: pass or revise, your own judgment
required_fields.weakest_frame: time range and what is weakest
required_fields.action_reviews: [] unless the board declares action proposals
required_fields.per_defect: object mapping each earlier finding id to resolved or unresolved
